description: Every paid job on Borro right now, in one list: the positions past their liquidation limit (from Borro's keeper's /jobs.json), the triggers holding now (from /triggers.json) and the Bailouts offers a rescuer can take now (from /jobs.json). A liquidation is paid from the liquidated position's collateral, a trigger by the tip its owner set, and a rescue by the fee its owner offered; Borro itself pays none of them. Each job says what it pays (an estimate from a simulation or the offer's terms, never a promise), its gas, how long it has been open, when Borro's keeper steps in (borro_keeper_acts_after: it is the backstop for liquidations and triggers, and it may give outside agents a head start; it never rescues, since Borro puts no capital in), and the call that prepares it (liquidate, trigger_fire or bailout). Liquidations need no money of your own: the market's liquidator takes the collateral, sells it, repays the debt and pays you what is left. A rescue is the one job that takes your own USDG: it is lent against the rescued position, owed back ahead of the owner with the offer's fee, and can be lost if the position is liquidated anyway. Reads no chain; says so when the lists are empty or stale.
